items.title: Check the message origin in the iframe loader

checks.command: KASVIMUSEO_IMAGE=kasvimuseo-dev-task23 nix-shell -p postgresql --run 'dev/kasvimuseo app build && dev/kasvimuseo app test'
KASVIMUSEO_IMAGE=kasvimuseo-dev-task23 KASVIMUSEO_BROWSER_ENGINES=chromium nix-shell -p postgresql --run 'dev/kasvimuseo app build && dev/kasvimuseo app browser-test'

f=kasvimuseo/static/js/kasvimuseo/planted-species-iframe.js && ! grep -nE 'document[.]write|innerHTML|attachEvent' "$f" && grep -qF 'event.origin !== catalogueOrigin' "$f" && grep -qF 'event.source !== plantedSpeciesFrame.contentWindow' "$f" && grep -qF 'line.textContent' "$f" && echo ok

test "$(git diff --name-only 9f475218559f0d0f57ee6f4a0c805693bed89b5c 1319cb1d75bb9667cb418ad81b56a655449807c5 | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = '.agents/memory/iframe-loader-checks.md README.rst browser_tests/test_iframe_loader.py docs/tasks/23-check-the-message-origin-in-the-iframe-loader.md kasvimuseo/static/js/kasvimuseo/planted-species-iframe.js ' && test "$(git rev-list --reverse 9f475218559f0d0f57ee6f4a0c805693bed89b5c..1319cb1d75bb9667cb418ad81b56a655449807c5 | tr '\n' ' ')" = '23795e61445f19c26c8774dc335b5770b685b405 31ecc70d21174fa328f4005d464c9d594493a452 1319cb1d75bb9667cb418ad81b56a655449807c5 ' && echo ok

added=$(git diff 9f475218559f0d0f57ee6f4a0c805693bed89b5c 1319cb1d75bb9667cb418ad81b56a655449807c5 | grep '^+' || true) && test -n "$added" && ! grep -nE '/home/|/tmp/claude|tinni|atom|hopeli|gogo|[.]kandev|[.]t3/' <<<"$added" && echo ok
